note: How the program talks to AutoCAD. Layout numbers live in layout_settings.json.
template_source: ~/Hyper Solutions/Hyper Document Library - Engineering/Electrical Team/CAD BLOCKS/TEMPLATE/HYPER_A.dwt
template_note: The team's template HYPER_A lives in SharePoint (template_source), like the symbol library. The configurator draws from its own copy (template_file), refreshed from the source by every release (tools/release.py) or by tools/update_template.py during development (decision 2026-10-20). Reading the shared template directly, without a release, comes much later.
keep_layouts_note: Template pages kept in every generated drawing, in this order, BEFORE the 3-line pages (ES_01 ...): the table of contents (page 1, decision 2026-11-10), the legend, then the BOM page (not used yet). Every other layout (empty pages) is deleted (decisions 2026-10-20). The drawing opens on ES_01.
keep_layout_frames_note: The frame (TITLE_BLOCK_MODEL, by its NAME) each kept layout shows; its page number is written there.
page_numbers_note: Generate writes each page's number into its frame's PAGE attribute (decision 2026-11-10, the rule of the engineers' NumberByLayout.lsp): 01, 02, 03... in tab order, the kept layouts first (TOC = 01), then ES_01, ES_02... The LISP gives the same numbers if run afterwards.
block_library_file: ~/Hyper Solutions/Hyper Document Library - Engineering/Electrical Team/CAD BLOCKS/Symbols-blocks.dwg
block_library_note: Blocks are copied from this library drawing (decision 2026-10-11). It is read in the background, never opened or changed.
paths_note: A path starting with ~ is in each person's own user folder (where SharePoint syncs), so the same file works on every PC. Relative paths are inside the configurator's folder.
jobs_folder: ~/Hyper Solutions/Hyper Document Library - Engineering/Electrical Team/CAD BLOCKS/CONFIGURATORS/Jobs
jobs_folder_note: Default folder for saving and opening projects (every user, every product line). Decision 2026-10-15.
switchboard_library_note: Ready-made switchboards (e.g. the sample) opened with File > Open from Library.
